name: Tutorial Jr. Sentinel drop table

item_resolution.evidence: game/data/canonical/items/347.json is the only local item named "Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece"; MeowDB's own drop entry for this owner (https://meowdb.com/msclassic/api/drops?monsterId=1, retrieved 2026-10-04T10:06:55.625Z; entry 87) carries item 347, the same id

source.row: Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece | Monster Drop | A hard piece of rock that forms the body of a Jr. | Common  /  Jr. Sentinel Shellpiece | Monster Drop | A hard shellpiece that's a part of Jr. | Common

meowdb_reference.note: MeowDB's read-only "MSEA reference drops" list from the live page: reference only, never a member (decision D3-11). item_id is MeowDB's own id for the name on the cached page (null when it does not name it once or no local item exists).

gaps: meso amount: MeowDB has no player meso report for this monster (newest source https://meowdb.com/msclassic/monsters/1, 2026-10-05T07:49:19.434Z: "No meso reports yet."); the runtime applies the meso rule of decision D3-12 (game/data/misostory/meso_rules.json: the level formula, or no mesos for an owner the rule exempts)
meso chance: MeowDB publishes none (its report form's dropChancePct is a constant the form fills in, not an observed chance); the runtime uses game/data/misostory/meso_rules.json (decision D3-12)

entries[].item_id.note: MeowDB's own cached drop entries for this owner: each member's item id is checked against them, and they decide between local items that share a name

gaps: drop chance: MeowDB and Henesys.gg publish none; the chance is the owner-approved table game/data/misostory/drop_rates.json (category x rarity, decision D3-11), applied at runtime
quantity: no source gives one; one item per drop (decision D3-11)
notes: Membership: MeowDB's community list "Drops (MS Classic)" on the live page (https://meowdb.com/msclassic/monsters/1, read 2026-10-05T07:49:19.434Z), every entry with its votes; nothing is excluded for votes (decision D3-11).
Rarity: Henesys.gg's label per item (https://henesys.gg/loot, read 2026-10-06T05:17:21.423Z; tools/henesys/captures/item_rarity.json).

Chance: the drop chance table game/data/misostory/drop_rates.json by chance_category x rarity.label (decision D3-11, verified: false). Quest-gated entries roll only while their quest is in progress (D3-9).

Mesos: MeowDB's player report when there is one (meso.amount_source); the rest of the rule (the level formula where MeowDB has no report, the chance, the owners without mesos) is game/data/misostory/meso_rules.json (decision D3-12).
Runtime (contract C1): an entry rolls only when item_id, rarity and chance_category are all resolved and quest_gate is null or its quest is in progress.
